rules: No source, connector, parser, model, browser or tenant workspace can directly mutate admitted foundation records.
Admission requires version-pinned evidence, rights, classification, policy and human decision.
Unknown, ambiguous, conflicting or stale inputs preserve uncertainty and cannot be coerced into canonical values.
Revocation, supersession and kill switches take precedence over cached resolution.
Every admitted change is append-only, reversible and explainable.
Object identifiers are opaque and immutable.
Payload hash covers canonical serialization and excludes volatile transport metadata.
Candidate and admitted stores are physically and logically separated.
History is preserved through supersession; destructive update is forbidden.
Foreign references are version-pinned or resolved at an explicit time.

join_rules: Cross-library joins preserve each record's jurisdiction, temporal, language, rights and document lineage.
A join cannot upgrade the least-authoritative input.
A revoked rights snapshot contributes zero materialized content.
A contested entity or taxonomy mapping remains contested in derived views.
Document anchors remain bound to exact document versions.
Currency or unit normalization requires explicit method and temporal context.

domain_invariants: A jurisdiction code is interpreted only with scheme, publisher, version and validity interval.
Disputed or overlapping boundaries remain explicit and cannot be silently collapsed.
Geometry is referenced by immutable content hash; coordinates are never inferred from labels.
Successor and predecessor relations preserve temporal direction.
Country, jurisdiction, place and administrative area are distinct object types.
Unknown jurisdiction is not replaced with tenant, source or user locale.
libraries.resolution: Return zero, one or many scoped candidates; ambiguity is a first-class result.

domain_invariants: Candidate matches never mutate or merge canonical entities.
Every merge decision records evidence, reviewer, policy version and reversible merge set.
Entity split restores prior identifiers, relations and lineage without information loss.
Observed ownership and inferred control are distinct assertions.
Ownership percentage, class, directness and validity interval are independently represented.
Person records default to restricted and require explicit processing authority.
libraries.resolution: Probabilistic candidates are proposals; admission requires deterministic policy and human authority.

domain_invariants: Every concept belongs to an immutable taxonomy version.
Source-native codes and labels are preserved verbatim beside normalized representations.
Crosswalk cardinality may be one-to-many or many-to-many.
Equivalence, broader, narrower and related mappings remain distinct.
Mapping confidence never converts a proposal into an admitted mapping.
Retired concepts remain resolvable for historical records.
libraries.resolution: Mappings return all applicable assertions with scope, method, confidence and lineage.

domain_invariants: Published, retrieved, observed, event, valid, effective, revised, vintage and recorded times are distinct axes.
Missing time, timezone or calendar remains unknown and is never replaced with now.
Unknown, unavailable, not-applicable and zero values are distinct states.
Currency conversion requires source value, rate, provider, rate timestamp and conversion method.
Ranges preserve lower and upper bounds, inclusivity and estimation status.
Restatements create new versions and never overwrite prior values.
libraries.resolution: Conversions and comparisons fail closed when required temporal, currency or unit context is absent.

domain_invariants: Source-native text is immutable and retained beside every normalized or translated value.
Language, script, region and locale are recorded independently.
Machine translation is labelled as proposed and cannot establish legal equivalence.
Terminology is scoped by domain, jurisdiction, organisation and validity interval.
Transliteration and translation are distinct transformations.
Unknown language is not inferred from country or source domain alone.
libraries.resolution: Return source-native, reviewed and proposed variants separately with provenance.

domain_invariants: Technical accessibility never implies collection, storage, display, export or training authority.
All ten rights dimensions are evaluated independently for action, purpose and destination.
Missing, ambiguous, conflicting, expired, suspended or revoked rights deny the affected action.
A kill switch overrides caches, retries, workers and previously allowed decisions.
Derived objects retain complete source, parser, transformation and rights lineage.
Rights snapshots are immutable and version-pinned.
libraries.resolution: Return ALLOW only for the requested dimension and context; all other outcomes deny.

domain_invariants: Document versions and extracted content are immutable and content-addressed.
Every extraction references exact source bytes, parser version and deterministic anchors.
A withdrawn, superseded or unavailable document is never represented as current.
Parser output cannot replace the raw reference or source-native structure.
Amendment, correction, supersession and attachment relations remain distinct.
Document authority is separate from extraction confidence and model interpretation.
libraries.resolution: Anchors resolve only against the exact version and fail closed on drift.
